Crispy Chicken is a fast food restaurant chain serving fried chicken & Chicken Sandwiches. The company Hamburg International Restaurants Co. is headquartered in Amman, Jordan. Franchising started in 2016 in Abu Dhabi, currently, 13 Stores are fully operated to serve our customers and we are still expanding in Jordan and regionally. 

We strive to achieve the optimum utilization of QUALITY of Product & Service, PRICE & TIME, our business model is based on maximizing value for money, and we strive to delight our customers and to serve the best fresh Chicken quality we can, all Crispy Chicken staff strongly believes in our slogan  The finest Chicken in Town and our Teams are committed to do their utmost effort to achieve our objectives.

Crispy Chicken provides fresh foods, big portions, good service, cheap prices, and a multi-choice menu, which combines the most successful fast food restaurant products. All these add up to good value for money for customers and generate increased brand loyalty. Our recipes of coated fried chicken are designed with a superior flavor to excite every customer.
